queries.sql: SELECT sl.scheme_name, dl.name AS department_name, ms.newschm_id, ms.newdepart_id, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN f1.min_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS applicationreceived, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN f2.min_id IS NOT NULL AND ms.sent_approve = '0' AND ms.reject_status = '0' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS UnattendedAppli, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN ms.sent_approve = '1' AND ms.sention_status = '0' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS applicationinprogress, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN ms.sent_approve = '1' AND (ms.sention_status = '1' OR ( (ms.reject_status IN ('1','2') AND ms.radiobuttonStatus = '5' AND ms.forwarded_to_bank IS NOT NULL) OR (ms.reject_status = '2' AND ms.radiobuttonStatus IS NULL) OR (ms.reject_status = '1' AND ms.radiobuttonStatus IS NULL AND ms.forwarded_to_bank IS NOT NULL) )) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS ApplicationsSanction, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN ms.sent_approve = '1' AND ms.sention_status = '1' AND ms.radiobuttonStatus IS NULL AND ms.forwarded_to_bank IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS ApplicationsPendingDept, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN ms.sent_approve = '1' AND ms.sention_status = '1' AND ms.radiobuttonStatus IN('7','12') AND ms.forwarded_to_bank IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS ApplicationsPendingDisburse, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN ms.forwarded_to_bank IS NOT NULL AND ms.radiobuttonStatus IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS bankpending, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN ms.reject_status IN ('1','2') AND ms.`radiobuttonStatus` IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS applicationinrejected, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN ms.reject_status IN ('2') AND ms.`radiobuttonStatus` IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS applicationinNotInterested, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN ms.reject_status IN ('1','2') AND ms.radiobuttonStatus='5' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS applicationinrejectedbybank, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN ms.forwarded_to_bank IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS fwdbank, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN ms.sent_approve = '1' AND ms.sention_status = '1' AND ms.radiobuttonStatus IN('1','7','12','13','14','15','16','21') AND ms.forwarded_to_bank IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS loanapplication, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN ms.radiobuttonStatus IN('1','13','14','15','16','21') AND ms.forwarded_to_bank IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS LoanDisbursed_1st, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN ms.sent_approve = '1' AND ms.sention_status = '1' AND ms.radiobuttonStatus IN ('2','9') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS employmentapplication, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN ms.sent_approve = '1' AND ms.sention_status = '1' AND (ms.radiobuttonStatus = '4' OR ms.training_honorarium_status IN ('2')) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS trainingcompletedapplication, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN ms.sent_approve = '1' AND ms.sention_status = '1' AND ms.training_honorarium_status IN ('1') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS trainingstartedapplication, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN ms.sent_approve = '1' AND ms.sention_status = '1' AND (ms.radiobuttonStatus = '6' OR ms.training_honorarium_status IN ('3')) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS honorariumGivenList, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN ms.sent_approve = '1' AND ms.sention_status = '1' AND ms.radiobuttonStatus IN ('1','12','13','14','15','16') AND ms.newdepart_id = '4' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS purchasing_done_1st, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN ms.radiobuttonStatus IN ('15','16') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS LoanDisbursed_2nd, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN ms.radiobuttonStatus IN ('13','14','15','16') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS subsidy_released_1st, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN ms.radiobuttonStatus IN ('14','15','16') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS purchasing_done_2nd, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN ms.radiobuttonStatus IN ('16') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS subsidy_released_2nd, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN ms.radiobuttonStatus IN ('17') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS assets_released, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN ms.is_final_benefit = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS finial_benefit_given, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN ms.radiobuttonStatus = '9' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS job_joined FROM member_schemes ms LEFT JOIN ( SELECT MIN(m.id) AS min_id FROM member_schemes m WHERE m.member_scheme_active = '1' AND m.noscheme = '0' AND app_version = 1 GROUP BY m.member_id ) f1 ON f1.min_id = ms.id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT MIN(m.id) AS min_id FROM member_schemes m WHERE NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM member_schemes x WHERE x.member_id = m.member_id AND x.member_scheme_active = '1' AND x.sent_approve = '1' ) AND m.member_scheme_active = '1' AND m.noscheme = '0' AND app_version = 1 GROUP BY m.member_id ) f2 ON f2.min_id = ms.id INNER JOIN scheme_list sl ON ms.newschm_id = sl.id INNER JOIN departments_list dl ON dl.id = ms.newdepart_id WHERE ms.newschm_id IN ('5','6','7','8','9','10','12','13','14','16','17','23','24','25','28','29','41','46','48','49','50','51','52','53','54','56','57','65','66','73','74','75','76','77') AND ms.member_scheme_active = '1' AND ms.noscheme = '0' AND ms.app_version = 1 GROUP BY ms.newschm_id, ms.newdepart_id, sl.scheme_name, dl.name ORDER BY applicationreceived DESC
